title: Quarterly roadmap: Sprint Blend + Risk Thermostat for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a single-quarter execution pattern (Sprint Blend) that balances runway and experiment lanes for hosted APIs and the model catalog, plus a lightweight operational gating mechanism (Risk Thermostat) that adjusts rollouts, deprecations, and capacity hedges based on observed signals.
background: Past quarters revealed friction between aggressive model rotations and capacity planning: teams either under-rotated models (risking stale UX) or over-rotated (causing regressions and cost spikes). Existing playbooks are fragmented across docs. This ticket consolidates an operational cadence and creates a measurable guardrail called the Risk Thermostat.
goals: Ship a documented Sprint Blend cadence for PM/ENG/SRE alignment
Operationalize a Risk Thermostat with three signal tiers (green/yellow/red) and automated fallback policies
Reduce model-rotation incidents caused by capacity mismatches by 40% vs prior quarter
Provide clear decision criteria for deprecations and canary windows tied to hosted API SLAs
success_criteria: Sprint Blend template created and adopted by at least 3 product squads
Risk Thermostat thresholds and automated fallback runbook validated in two canaries
Dashboard showing thermostat signals published in Console (token-level cost and latency breakdown)
deliverables: Sprint Blend cadence doc (Confluence) - public playbook
Risk Thermostat config (YAML) for routing policies and automated fallback
Two canary runs: model rotation + rollback automation tested
Cross-team onboarding session and a short recording
